introduction: In Andhra Pradesh, Hindu Marriage Registration is governed by the Hindu Marriage Act. It is applicable only for residents of Andhra Pradesh marrying under Hindu customs, providing legal validity to the marriage.
quickFacts:
Important to Know
  • Service Name: Hindu Marriage Registration
  • Applicability: Only for people residing in Andhra Pradesh marrying under the Hindu Marriage Act.
  • Application Fees: ₹500 for Same Caste marriages; ₹0 (Free) for Inter-caste marriages.
  • Important Surname Tip: It is strongly advised not to change the wife's surname during this application process. Doing so will require updating all her other major documents (Aadhaar, Passport, educational certificates, etc.). It is much easier to keep the surname exactly as it appears on her current Aadhaar Card and 10th Marks Memo.
documentsRequired:
Documents Required (Max file size 1MB; PDF, JPG, JPEG, or PNG)

Identity, Age & Residence Proof
  • Age Proof (Husband & Wife): Birth Certificate / SSC Marks Memo / Passport / Notary Affidavit. (SSC Marks Memo is highly recommended for both).
  • Residence Proof (Husband & Wife): Aadhaar Card is highly recommended for both.
  • Passport Photos: Separate passport-size photos for both the Husband and Wife.
Wedding Proofs
  • Wedding Card: Hard copy of the invitation.
  • Marriage Photo: A clear photo of the couple together in their wedding attire.
  • Marriage Function Hall Receipt (Optional): Receipt from the mandapam or temple where the marriage took place.
onlineApplication:
Online Application Process

Apply online through the official Andhra Pradesh Registration and Stamps Department website.

  1. Portal Access: Visit registration.ap.gov.in.
  2. Navigate to Registration: Click on the "Hindu Marriage Registration" icon on the homepage.
  3. User Registration/Login: Register as a new user using your email address, verify it via OTP, and set up your password. Existing users can log in directly.
  4. Start New Application: Click on the "Apply for New Registration" button.
  5. Fill Husband & Wife Details: Enter the Aadhaar numbers for both husband and wife and authenticate via OTP to auto-populate most details. Manually fill remaining fields: Full Name, Date of Birth, Address, Parents' names, Religion (Hindu), Caste Type (Same/Different), Caste Name, Mobile Number, and divorce status.
  6. Marriage Details: Enter the Date of Marriage and Place of Marriage. Tip: Select the location (District/Mandal/Village) that is convenient for you to visit the Sub-Registrar Office (SRO), rather than the exact village where the marriage took place, if they are different.
  7. Select SRO: Based on the location details, select the appropriate Sub-Registrar Office from the dropdown menu.
  8. Certificate Copies & Slot Booking: Select the number of certificate copies required (usually 2). Book your preferred date and time slot from the calendar and confirm with an OTP.
  9. Upload Documents: Upload all the required documents (under 1MB, PDF/JPG formats).
  10. Save and Pay: Save as draft, review the application, and pay the fee (₹500 for same caste; ₹0 for inter-caste) using credit/debit card, UPI, or net banking to submit your application.
offlineApplication:
Mandatory Physical Verification at SRO

Although the initial application is submitted online, a physical visit to the Sub-Registrar Office (SRO) is mandatory to complete the registration:

  1. Visit on Slot Date: Both husband and wife must visit the selected SRO on the date and time of the booked slot.
  2. Carry Documents: Bring all original copies of the documents uploaded online for verification by officials.
  3. Biometric Verification: Complete the biometric KYC scanning for both spouses at the office.
afterApplying:
After Applying — Status & Approval

WhatsApp Notifications

Once submitted, you will receive your application details and reference number on your registered WhatsApp numbers.

Status Tracking

The application status will show as "Pending" until the physical visit, document verification, and biometric verification are completed at the SRO.

Certificate Issuance

Once the SRO officials verify your details, your application status will update to "Completed", and you will receive your official Hindu Marriage Certificate copies.
